# graviteeam_protected_resource_secret (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM protected resource client secret

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_domain" "example" {
  name = "customer-portal"
  oidc {}
  login_settings {}
}

resource "graviteeam_protected_resource" "example" {
  domain_id            = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name                 = "MCP Server"
  type                 = "MCP_SERVER"
  resource_identifiers = ["https://api.example.com/mcp"]

  feature {
    key         = "list_items"
    type        = "MCP_TOOL"
    description = "List items"
    scopes      = ["openid"]
  }
}

resource "graviteeam_protected_resource_secret" "example" {
  domain_id             = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  protected_resource_id = graviteeam_protected_resource.example.id
  name                  = "terraform-managed"
  renew_trigger         = "rotation-2026-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `name` (String) The name of the protected resource secret
- `protected_resource_id` (String) The ID of the protected resource

### Optional

- `renew_trigger` (String) Arbitrary value used to explicitly renew the secret. Changing this value calls the Gravitee AM renewal endpoint and stores the newly returned secret.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) The expiration timestamp of the secret when configured by Gravitee AM
- `id` (String) The ID of the protected resource secret
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The generated client secret value. Gravitee AM only returns the clear value at creation or renewal time.
- `settings_id` (String) The secret settings ID returned by Gravitee AM
